name: yuzread
description: Standalone CBZ reader with continuous scrolling and a JSON-driven frameless window

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:electron && node electron-built/prepare-types.cjs && node electron-built/install-electron.cjs
scripts.runtime: npm run build:electron && node electron-built/prepare-types.cjs && node electron-built/install-electron.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.screen.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check:code: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run check:contracts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:contracts && npm run build:electron && npm run build:screen
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.screen.json --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
